from dataclasses import FrozenInstanceError
import unittest

from textstats import TextStats, count_text


class PublicApiTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Exercise the supported facade without internal-module imports."""

    def test_public_counting_call(self):
        result = count_text("one two\nthree")
        self.assertIsInstance(result, TextStats)
        self.assertEqual((result.lines, result.words), (2, 3))
        self.assertIs(type(result.lines), int)
        self.assertIs(type(result.words), int)

    def test_result_is_immutable(self):
        result = TextStats(2, 3)
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            result.lines = 9
        with self.assertRaises(FrozenInstanceError):
            result.words = 9
        self.assertEqual(result, TextStats(2, 3))

"""Verify pure counting semantics against independently hand-counted inputs."""

import unittest

from textstats.counting import TextStats, count_text


class CountingTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """Protect newline, word, empty-input, and BOM counting boundaries."""

    def test_contract_examples(self):
        cases = [
            ("", 0, 0),
            ("alpha beta", 1, 2),
            ("alpha\n", 1, 1),
            ("\n", 1, 0),
            ("alpha\r\nbeta\rgamma\n", 3, 3),
            ("alpha\n\n", 2, 1),
            (" \t", 1, 0),
            ("alpha\u2028beta", 1, 2),
        ]
        for text, lines, words in cases:
            with self.subTest(text=text):
                self.assertEqual(count_text(text), TextStats(lines, words))

    def test_each_terminator_and_final_segment(self):
        for terminator in ("\n", "\r", "\r\n"):
            with self.subTest(terminator=terminator):
                self.assertEqual(count_text(terminator), TextStats(1, 0))
                self.assertEqual(count_text("a" + terminator), TextStats(1, 1))
                self.assertEqual(count_text("a" + terminator + "b"), TextStats(2, 2))
                self.assertEqual(count_text(terminator * 2), TextStats(2, 0))
        self.assertEqual(count_text("a\r\n\nb\r\nc"), TextStats(4, 3))

    def test_unicode_whitespace_does_not_add_lines(self):
        self.assertEqual(count_text("café\u00a0東京\u2029end\v\f"), TextStats(1, 3))

    def test_bom_only_and_retention(self):
        self.assertEqual(count_text("\ufeff"), TextStats(0, 0))
        self.assertEqual(count_text("\ufeff", strip_bom=False), TextStats(1, 1))
        self.assertEqual(count_text("\ufeff alpha\n"), TextStats(1, 1))
        self.assertEqual(count_text("\ufeff alpha\n", strip_bom=False), TextStats(1, 2))

    def test_strip_exactly_one_leading_bom_and_preserve_interior(self):
        self.assertEqual(count_text("\ufeff\ufeff"), TextStats(1, 1))
        self.assertEqual(count_text(" \ufeff "), TextStats(1, 1))
        self.assertEqual(count_text("a \ufeff b"), TextStats(1, 3))

"""Count logical lines and Unicode whitespace-separated words in decoded text."""

from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class TextStats:
    """Immutable counts of logical lines and whitespace-separated words.

    Attributes:
        lines: Number of logical lines in the counted text.
        words: Number of Unicode whitespace-separated tokens.
    """

    lines: int
    words: int


def count_text(text: str, *, strip_bom: bool = True) -> TextStats:
    """Count logical lines and Unicode whitespace-separated tokens.

    CRLF is one terminator; lone CR and LF also terminate lines. A trailing
    terminator creates no extra line, and other Unicode separators affect only
    word splitting. The function performs no IO and retains no caller state.

    Args:
        text: Decoded text to count.
        strip_bom: Remove exactly one leading U+FEFF when true. Interior BOMs
            and all BOMs when false remain ordinary non-whitespace characters.

    Returns:
        An immutable TextStats value containing nonnegative integer counts.
        Empty text after BOM handling has zero lines and words.
    """
    if strip_bom and text.startswith("\ufeff"):
        text = text[1:]
    normalized = text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n")
    lines = normalized.count("\n")
    if normalized and not normalized.endswith("\n"):
        lines += 1
    return TextStats(lines=lines, words=len(text.split()))
